quotes.name: Daniel Cloak
quotes.quote: I’ve heard folks talking about the Stabilization Fund at the bakery—some hopeful, some skeptical, but everyone’s watching to see where it lands.

quotes.name: Irene Fay
quotes.quote: I've heard folks at the coffee shop talking about the Stabilization Fund, but honestly, it feels like one of those things that happens somewhere else—like I see the signs about meetings sometimes, but it doesn't touch my day-to-day yet.

quotes.name: Talmon Lint
quotes.quote: I’ve heard folks talking about the Stabilization Fund at the community center, but honestly, I’ve been so tied up with installations that I haven’t seen much of its impact firsthand.

quotes.name: Darius Clark
quotes.quote: I’ve heard folks talking about the Stabilization Fund, but honestly, I haven’t seen much change around here yet. It’s hard to tell where the money’s going.

claim: I’ve heard folks talking about the Stabilization Fund at the bakery—some hopeful, some skeptical, but everyone’s watching to see where it lands.
